subject: The newsletters your crawl can't reach
body:
Newsletters are the one publishing format a public web crawl cannot reach: they arrive by email and they live behind Substack and beehiiv, so the text never enters the graph.

NewsletterFIT reads that layer and returns graph shaped records: companies, people, guests, topics and sponsor placements, with the publication, the article URL and the date attached, extracted by AI from the issue itself.

The nearest crawl vendors in our graph show how thin that coverage is: Bright Data in 8 articles, Apify in 9, Diffbot not at all.

I can send a sample of the records for a sector you already hold, mapped against your ontology.
